sources.excerpt: --> Mid-Fi Electronics ::: Another/An-other (Fuzz Version) HOME PEDALS PURCHASE Another/An-other (Fuzz Version) The Another/An-other is a frequency dependent fuzz/chopper. First your signal is fuzzed up and split in two. Half goes to an electronic switch then the output. The other half goes to a frequency divider which divides whatever you play in half (up to 12 times via the “Frequency” rotary switch). That signal then tells the electronic switch when to turn on/off. The result? A choppy/fuzzy trem/ring mod/divider who’s frequency changes based on what note(s) you’re playing!!! CONTROLS Volume Rotary switch for frequency division range FEATURES True Bypass 9V DC (negative tip) all content © 2026 Doug Tuttle Effects

This wild pedal transforms your playing into a swirling, choppy, and unpredictable soundscape. Whether you want a glitchy tremolo effect or a fuzzed-out ring modulator vibe, this pedal reacts dynamically to your notes, creating textures youve never heard before. Mid-Fi Electronics Another/An-other (Fuzz Version) Pedal Review This isn’t just another fuzzits a whole new way to shape your sound. The Another/An-other Fuzz takes your guitar signal, splits it in two, and lets one half control a switchable chopper effect based on the frequencies you play. The result is an evolving, rhythmic fuzz that sounds like a blend of tremolo, ring mod, and octave-down madness. With intuitive controls and a world of chaotic sonic possibilities, this pedal is perfect for players who love to experiment.
